Display a track object in an igvShiny widget

Source: R/tracks.R
loadTrack.Rd

loadTrack is the one loader for every track class: it turns track into a payload with the builder of its class and sends it to the browser, removing an earlier track of the same name first. Annotation tracks are served as a bed file, quantitative tracks travel inline, exactly as with loadBedTrack and loadBedGraphTrack.

track can also be a plain igv.js track configuration, a named list with at least name, url and one of type or format. It loads any track type igv.js reads from a url, e.g. a bigBed file, without a dedicated loader. Keys igv.js does not read are dropped with a warning, as with trackConfig; a trackConfig passed with a config list is ignored with a logged warning.

Usage

loadTrack(session, id, track, ...)

# S4 method for class 'Track'
loadTrack(session, id, track, ...)

# S4 method for class 'igvAnnotationTrack'
loadTrack(
  session,
  id,
  track,
  deleteTracksOfSameName = TRUE,
  trackConfig = list(),
  validateReference = TRUE
)

# S4 method for class 'QuantitativeTrack'
loadTrack(
  session,
  id,
  track,
  deleteTracksOfSameName = TRUE,
  trackConfig = list(),
  validateReference = TRUE
)

Arguments

session

an environment or list, provided and managed by shiny

id

character string, the html element id of this widget instance

track

an object of a Track subclass, e.g. DataFrameAnnotationTrack or GRangesQuantitativeTrack, or a named list holding an igv.js track configuration

...

arguments of the methods: deleteTracksOfSameName (logical, default TRUE), trackConfig (a named list of additional igv.js track configuration options, merged onto the track's own) and validateReference (logical, default TRUE: check the track contigs and coordinates against the active reference genome)

deleteTracksOfSameName

logical, default TRUE

trackConfig

a named list of additional igv.js track configuration options

validateReference

logical flag, default TRUE

Value

nothing

Examples

tbl <- data.frame(chrom = "chr1", start = c(100, 300), end = c(200, 400),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
track <- DataFrameAnnotationTrack("demo", tbl, color = "red")
if (interactive()) {
  # inside a shiny server function, with an igvShiny output "igvShiny_0":
  # loadTrack(session, "igvShiny_0", track)
}

# any igv.js track type from a url, here a bigBed file; nothing is
# fetched until the browser draws the track
bigBed <- list(name = "genes", type = "annotation", format = "bigBed",
               url = "https://example.org/genes.bb")
if (interactive()) {
  # loadTrack(session, "igvShiny_0", bigBed)
}
